newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday were quiet, with no trade, market sources said.
Sales this week totalled slightly over 80,000 head, above the estimated showlist of 72,600. Prices were $118.00 to $120.00, with most at $119.00 per cwt on a dressed basis.
On a live basis, most sales were $73.00 to $74.00, with a few loads at $75.00 deliered in eastern Nebraska for highly choice cattle.
Next week's showlist was expected to be about the same size as this week, with cattle owners asking about $122.00 on a dressed basis and $75.00 to $76.00/ live.
